name: Rock 'n' Roll Las Vegas Half Marathon
typicalWeather: Average air temperature about 18 °C (65 °F), per the race site
summary: The Rock 'n' Roll Las Vegas Half Marathon is run in the evening on the closed Las Vegas Strip. It starts at New York-New York and finishes at the Bellagio, all on Las Vegas Boulevard. The start time is 4:30 p.m., so much of the race is run after dark.
courseHighlights: Start on Las Vegas Boulevard at New York-New York
The whole route is on the closed Las Vegas Strip
Neon lights along the Strip at night
Finish on Las Vegas Boulevard at the Bellagio

paceStrategy.summary: The course is a straight run down one road and is described as flat by HalfRuns and a USATF certification listing. Pace evenly and watch for crowding in the first miles.

segments.advice: Start at goal pace or a little slower, as thousands of runners start together.
Hold an even rhythm and take fuel on a schedule.
Speed up if you feel strong, and watch for crowds near the finish.

fuelingNotes: No aid-station positions were found on the pages we checked. Because the race starts at 4:30 p.m., eat a normal lunch and plan your gels on a time schedule.
tips: Plan your day around the 4:30 p.m. start, with a light meal 3–4 hours before
Bring a light layer for the wait, as it cools after sunset
Walk to the start early; the Strip is closed to traffic on race day
Check the current course map, as the race says courses are subject to change

faq.question: Is the Rock 'n' Roll Las Vegas Half Marathon flat?
faq.answer: Yes. HalfRuns rates it ultra-flat, and a USATF certification listing calls it relatively flat with minimal net elevation change. We found no official gain or loss figure.

faq.question: Where does the Rock 'n' Roll Las Vegas Half Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts on Las Vegas Boulevard at New York-New York and finishes on Las Vegas Boulevard at the Bellagio.

faq.question: When is the Rock 'n' Roll Las Vegas Half Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is held on a Sunday in February, with a 4:30 p.m. start.
